BiblicalUsage: Ahumai is named once, as a son of Jahath in the genealogy of Judah, among the families of the Zorathites.
TheologicalSignificance: The Bible leaves this name bare, and I refuse to dress it up into a lesson. The family is remembered because the tribe kept its records.
